title: Recursive fibre powers of the projective line
statement: For a scheme $T$, let $q:\mathbf P^1_T\to T$ be the projective-line projection, with $\mathbf P^1_T=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};T)$ of [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Define schemes $X_n$ with morphisms $p_n:X_n\to T$ recursively: $X_0=T$, $p_0=\mathrm{id}_T$; $X_{n+1}=X_n\times_T\mathbf P^1_T$, the chosen fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of $p_n$ and $q$, and $p_{n+1}=p_n\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$. The pair $(X_n,p_n)$ is the $n$-fold fibre power of the projective line over $T$.
